What Drives Interior Painting Costs

If you’ve ever gotten two very different painting quotes, this is why.

Interior painting isn’t priced randomly — it’s based on how much prep, time, and detail your home actually requires.

  • Wall condition: repairs, cracks, or previous damage

  • Drywall work: patches, texture, or full repairs

  • Ceiling height: higher ceilings increase labor and access needs

  • Trim detail: crown molding, baseboards, and casing

  • Number of colors: more colors = more time and precision

  • Occupied vs empty home: working around furniture adds time

What’s Included in Our Interior Painting

  • Professional paint application

  • Cleanup and final walkthrough

  • Warranty options

No vague pricing. No hidden fees.

What Impacts Whether You’re at the Low or High End

Lower End of the Range

  • Minimal repairs
  • Standard ceiling height
  • Fewer colors
  • Simple layouts
  • Empty home

Higher End of the Range

  • Extensive repairs
  • High ceilings
  • Detailed trim or crown molding
  • Multiple colors or accent walls
  • Occupied home with furniture

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to paint a room?

Most rooms range from $500 to $1,500 depending on size and condition.

Can I paint just the walls?

Yes, but many homeowners choose to include ceilings and trim for a more complete finish.

Do you include drywall repairs?

Minor repairs are included. Larger repairs are quoted separately.

How long does interior paint last?

With proper prep and materials, interior paint can last 5–10 years depending on wear.
